jay_cs: Quick heads-up — ZenfolioThera requests a short lived regional QPS bump + egress allowlist for their EU pilot tomorrow. They want to avoid 429s during dataset seeding. @marta_ops can you take point?

marta_ops: Yep. Need exact CIDRs, region, desired QPS, and duration. Also add a short business justification for tracking.

jay_cs: CIDRs: 44.33.12.0/24 and 44.33.12.78/32. Region: eu-west-1. Current baseline 60 QPS -> request 320 QPS for 36 hours. Reason: bulk indexing + prefix-cold caches during rollout. They asked if we can populate KV cache for top 50 user prefixes prior to cutover.

ishaan_eng: I can patch rate-limiter and set auto-revoke at 36h. Will add alerting for 5xx and token-latency regressions. Staging cmd I used: ```bash
redwoodctl customers set --id zenfolio-thera --allowlist 44.33.12.0/24,44.33.12.78 --qps 320 --region eu-west-1 --revoke 36h
```

marta_ops: Running that in staging now, smoke test plan: 1) synthetic burst to 400 qps, 2) check 5xx, 3) verify allowlist and source IP mapping. @jay_cs paste sanitized prod payload for runbook.

jay_cs: Prod payload (sanitized):
```json
{"customer_id":"zenfolio-thera","change":{"region":"eu-west-1","qps":320,"allowlist":["44.33.12.0/24","44.33.12.78/32"],"auto_revoke":"36h"},"requested_by":"jay_cs"}
```

infra-bot: infra-bot: change-request created (#CS-9120) by marta_ops - pending infra review

ishaan_eng: Staging looks good. Scheduling prod window at 08:45 UTC in ~20m. Post-change checks: QPS, 5xx ratio, p95/p99 tail latency, KV hit-rate. Rollback criteria: 5xx > 1% or KV hit-rate drops >10% vs baseline.

marta_ops: Deployed at 08:47 UTC. Control plane returned revoke timestamp: 2026-04-03T08:47:00Z. CLI output truncated in runbook.

jay_cs: Customer reports initial index jobs started, no 429s. Observed 5xx ~0.12%, p99 within SLA. I'll kick off KV pre-warm job against top-50 prefixes now and attach logs to ticket.

claire_ae: I'll mention this successful ramp in the renewal conversation — renewal in ~25 days. Good operational scorecard helps reduce churn risk. DM me dashboard access if you want me to include charts.

jay_cs: Action items: 1) confirm revoke runs after 36h (marta_ops), 2) attach KV warmup KB + logs to ticket (jay_cs), 3) AE renewal follow-up with charts (claire_ae). Leaving thread open for revoke confirmation. Thanks everyone!
